install_proposal: Atomically replace only these five existing evaluators using evaluate_for(id), retain existing register safety/provider-managed wrapping and UI groups, apply exact reviewed copy and native overlay successors; never alter historical CASES or signed manifests.

historical_description.description: Checks complete Ingress annotations for keys containing snippet.
historical_description.fail_when: Ingress has any annotation whose key contains 'snippet'.
historical_description.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); filtered annotations (annotations_complete != true) yield UNKNOWN.
historical_description.pass_when: No annotation matches the condition in a complete annotation projection.

per_id.source_semantics: Same literal case-sensitive old criterion; no nginx execution or new numbered compliance mapping.

historical_description.description: Matches the text alias inside snippet annotation values.
historical_description.fail_when: Ingress has a snippet annotation whose value contains 'alias'.
historical_description.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); filtered annotations (annotations_complete != true) yield UNKNOWN.
historical_description.pass_when: No annotation matches the condition in a complete annotation projection.

per_id.source_semantics: Same literal case-sensitive old criterion; no nginx execution or new numbered compliance mapping.

historical_description.description: Matches Lua-like markers or kubernetes.io text in snippet annotations.
historical_description.fail_when: Ingress has a snippet annotation whose value matches lua_, _lua or the literal 'kubernetes.io'.
historical_description.not_applicable_when: Only when the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); filtered annotations (annotations_complete != true) yield UNKNOWN.
historical_description.pass_when: No annotation matches the condition in a complete annotation projection.

per_id.source_semantics: Same literal case-sensitive old criterion; no nginx execution or new numbered compliance mapping.

historical_description.description: On legacy clusters, checks PSP default seccomp annotation for runtime/default or docker/default.
historical_description.fail_when: The annotation is absent or set to another value.
historical_description.not_applicable_when: When the cluster's Kubernetes version is 1.25 or later (PodSecurityPolicy API removed), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); missing version is UNKNOWN. Filtered annotations are UNKNOWN.
historical_description.pass_when: The default seccomp annotation is runtime/default or docker/default.

per_id.source_semantics: Same exact legacy runtime/default/docker/default or SELinux MustRunAs alternatives; modern API-removal applicability preserved.

historical_description.description: On legacy clusters, checks PSP SELinux MustRunAs or recognized AppArmor/seccomp default annotations.
historical_description.fail_when: None of the SELinux, AppArmor or seccomp defaults is present.
historical_description.not_applicable_when: When the cluster's Kubernetes version is 1.25 or later (PodSecurityPolicy API removed), or the object is provider/control-plane managed (k8s_managed re-labels non-passing results); missing version is UNKNOWN.
historical_description.pass_when: seLinux.rule is MustRunAs, or an AppArmor/seccomp default-profile annotation is runtime/default (docker/default for seccomp).

per_id.source_semantics: Same exact legacy runtime/default/docker/default or SELinux MustRunAs alternatives; modern API-removal applicability preserved.

schema.collection_binding: Actual HTTP200 full-JSON inventory GET, source path, requested scope, native resource ID and nonce-bearing configured SDK origin/auth context digest. Complete native envelope required.
schema.identity_binding: Canonical native apiVersion/kind/namespace/name/UID/resourceVersion digest; endpoint-derived type may replace omitted TypeMeta only.
